premises.text: Many people with mental health conditions get no care, and institutional spend often fails to reach those most at risk
premises.evidence_span: two in three of those diagnosed get zero care whatsoever

premises.text: A mobile app delivers text-based group psychotherapy moderated by therapists, combining peer support with scheduled VoIP therapy
premises.evidence_span: a mobile app for text-based group psychotherapy powered by natural language processing

premises.text: NLP flags suicidality and maliciousness, including nuanced and context-dependent messages, so providers intervene when needed
premises.evidence_span: advanced NLP algorithms to run on user messages and detect messages containing suicidality or maliciousness

premises.text: Anonymous groups of five to seven users reduce stigma while keeping groups clinically moderated
premises.evidence_span: Users join groups anonymously, which greatly reduces their fear of stigma and judgment

premises.text: B2B SaaS licenses the stack to organizations that already have providers so end users pay nothing
premises.evidence_span: we deploy with the B2B SaaS enterprise model, where we license out this technology to organizations that already have an infrastructure of providers

premises.text: Early focus is insular stigmatized organizations such as fire departments, universities, and police, then larger systems and NLP API services
premises.evidence_span: Our early adopters include fire departments, universities, and police departments

domains.name: Group therapy app and NLP safety

value.text: Broader access to safer, scalable psychotherapy that makes providers more efficient
value.evidence_span: broaden access to care to patients, but also gives today's overburdened providers a means to scale

secondary_value.text: Reduced crisis incidents and better population health insights for institutions
secondary_value.evidence_span: detect complications early and reduce the number of crisis incidences within a population

provide services to the end user at no charge to them
